SELECT o.*, u.account AS user_account FROM goods_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE o.is_deleted = 0
AND o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC
